abstract.text: Locations are the places your team needs to find or visit, such as entrances, rooms, checkpoints, or delivery points.

inlineContent.text: Add and edit Locations from the Map. A Location has a position and can belong to a Region and Layer. Tap its marker and choose Detail to learn more. Routes reuse Project Locations as Stops, so you can plan new Activities from the same places.

abstract.text: Learn how to organize places and work in LinkMap on iOS and the web.
The Map is the first screen in LinkMap. It stays visible even before you choose a Project.
